description: Abstract class defining WebSocket subscription context for Thingsboard server, including session management, locking, and message sending.

classes.name: TbAbstractSubCtx
classes.description: Abstract class managing WebSocket subscription context, including session info, locking, and message dispatch.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the subscription context is dynamic.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Sets the stopped flag to true, indicating the subscription should be terminated.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the session ID associated with this subscription context.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID from the session security context.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID from the session security context.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID from the session security context.

methods.name: getOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the owner ID, prioritizing customer ID if available, otherwise tenant ID.

methods.name: sendWsMsg
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket update message, ensuring thread safety via locking.
